Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Developed by Militech, the "Falcon" is hands down the best and most advanced Sandevistan OS out there. The nickname is no accident - the peregrine falcon was once one of the fastest animals in the world, as this software is among cyberware.

Sandevistan Operating System. The Sandevistan now counts as Borgware for Max Humanity Loss, and every time a non-FBC user without a Cyberspine activates it, they suffer 1d6 Humanity Loss.

The Sandevistan can now be activated without an Action, its Initiative Bonus is increased by 1 (+4), and its duration is reduced to 9 seconds (3 Rounds). While active, the user can dodge Ranged Attacks regardless of their REF (if they could not already). At the start of a user’s Turn while Sandevistan is active, they must choose to gain either +2 MOVE until the end of their Turn, or a +4 bonus to a single Evasion Check that they make before the start of their next Turn.

The Sandevistan cannot be activated again for an hour unless the user voluntarily suffers 3 Humanity Loss per consecutive activation before an hour passes (e.g., 3 -> 6 -> 9, etc).

Enhances: Sandevistan
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Change the Sandevistan's initiative effect to +4 while this OS is installed.
  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Sandevistan Operating Systems).
